comparison.objective: Extract a locked terminal, versus select a fitting wrench, loosen a captive nut, and open a latch arm.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine blade insertion and simultaneous wire/tool withdrawal, versus wrench-size discrimination and controlled torque.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal removed without connector damage or unintended release; versus nut backed off, arm opened, no rounding, and a 20-second hands-off hold.
comparison.reason: Tool use is shared only generically; the contact mechanics and tested abilities differ.
